福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

愛國婦人會館Patriotic Women's Hall

孔廟附近有一棟帶著西洋風味的日式老房子。我們來看外觀、走進室內，聽聽它的故事。愛國婦人會 1901 年在東京成立。台南支部的會館在 1940 年落成。由下往上看：洗石子基座、一樓的面磚、二樓的雨淋板，最上面是日式屋瓦。再靠近一點看。入口和樓梯間的八角窗是狹長形的。出窗從牆面突出，由木托架撐著。車寄讓客人下車時不會淋濕。一進門有馬賽克地磚和木樓梯。上樓前請脫鞋！樓上有榻榻米和室，還有床之間，是擺掛軸或花的小凹室。一張榻榻米是一疊，大約 91 乘 182 公分。兩疊大約是一坪。戰後：1948 年起是美國新聞處，1950 年起借給紅十字會，1979 年後成為市立圖書館分館。2012 年起是臺南創意中心。

Near the Confucius Temple stands an old Japanese house with Western touches. Let's look outside, step inside, and hear its story. The Patriotic Women's Association was founded in Tokyo in 1901. Its Tainan branch hall was completed in 1940. Look from the bottom up: a washed terrazzo base, facing tiles on the ground floor, clapboard upstairs, and Japanese roof tiles on top. Look closer. The octagonal windows at the entrance and staircase are slim. Bay windows stick out from the wall, held up by wooden brackets. The carriage porch kept guests dry as they got out of a car. Inside the door are mosaic floor tiles and a wooden staircase. Take off your shoes before going upstairs! There is a tatami room with a tokonoma, a small alcove for a hanging scroll or flowers. One tatami mat is one jo, about 91 by 182 centimeters. Two mats make about one ping. After the war: the United States Information Service from 1948, the Red Cross from 1950, and a city library branch after 1979. Since 2012, it is Creative Tainan.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

愛國婦人會館是一棟帶著西洋風味的日式建築，就在孔廟附近。洗石子基座、面磚、雨淋板和日式屋瓦層層疊上，樓上還有榻榻米和室，是認識日治時期和洋建築的好例子。

The Patriotic Women's Hall near the Confucius Temple is a Japanese building with Western touches. Its washed-stone base, tiled walls, wooden siding and tatami rooms upstairs make it a fine example of Japanese-era mixed design.

  1. 1901愛國婦人會在東京成立。The Patriotic Women's Association is founded in Tokyo.
  2. 1940台南支部會館落成。The Tainan branch hall is completed.
  3. 1948–1979先後作為美國新聞處、紅十字會與市立圖書館分館。It serves as a US information office, a Red Cross office and a city library branch.
  4. 2012成為臺南創意中心。It becomes the Tainan Creative Center.

實景照片

Photos on site

會館外觀 The hall from outside

這棟兩層樓的會館在 1940 年蓋好，融合了日式和西洋的風格。一樓外牆貼面磚，二樓是一片片水平木板，屋頂鋪日式屋瓦。

This two-story hall was finished in 1940. It mixes Japanese and Western styles. The ground floor has tiles, the upper floor has wooden boards, and the roof has Japanese-style tiles.

門口的木招牌 The name board

大門旁邊掛著直直的木頭招牌，寫著「愛國婦人會館」。紅褐色的木門上有細長的玻璃窗。

A tall wooden sign by the door shows the hall's name in Chinese. The reddish-brown wooden doors have long, narrow glass windows.

菱格紋木門 Diamond-pattern doors

入口的大木門是一格一格的菱形花樣。旁邊牆上是一個細長的八角窗。

The big wooden doors at the entrance have a diamond pattern. On the wall nearby is a slim octagonal window.

會館模型 Model of the hall

玻璃櫃裡有一座會館的小模型。從上面看，可以看到屋頂和整棟房子的樣子。

Inside a glass case is a small model of the hall. From above, you can see the roofs and the shape of the whole building.

木頭插座蓋 Wooden outlet cover

連插座蓋都是木頭做的，上面還刻了一朵四瓣的花！

Even the outlet covers are made of wood, with a carved flower!

打開看看 Look underneath

把花朵蓋子移開，下面就藏著插座。

Move the flower lid aside, and you find the socket hiding underneath.

室內八角窗 Indoor octagonal window

這個八角窗在室內，形狀比較接近正八角形。從窗戶可以看到裡面的房間。

This octagonal window is indoors, and its shape is closer to a regular octagon. You can peek through it into the room.

木樓梯 Wooden staircase

木樓梯通往二樓。上樓前要先脫鞋，保護老木頭地板。

This wooden staircase leads upstairs. Take off your shoes first to protect the old wooden floor.

二樓的房間 Upstairs

二樓有長長的房間和外側廊道，一排排木格窗讓陽光照進來。

Upstairs, a long room sits next to a bright veranda. Rows of wooden windows let the sunlight in.
